text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Mainichi Hai, the 
public had begun buzzing with talk of the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The Satsuki Sho is a chaotic contest. 
Umamusume to watch are—" No mention of me, 
huh...
choice_data_list: Are you worried about your evaluation?
Are you concerned about what people think?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am not concerned about it. Their 
opinions will change after the Mainichi 
Hai anyway.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —No, it must be changed.

Far from being discouraged by the lack of 
recognition, Yaeno Muteki seemed all the 
more fired up. This side of her is truly 
dependable.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, who is the opponent we 
should be most wary of in the Mainichi 
Hai?

Oguri Cap, an Umamusume from Kasamatsu. 
She is one of Yaeno Muteki's 
contemporaries.

Her abilities were already highly 
regarded. As word of her reputation 
spread, she began drawing immense 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, Oguri-san is held in high regard. 
Judging by her everyday training, she 
seems quite capable."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The stronger the opponent, the 
hotter my fire burns.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall overpower and defeat them 
for you to see!
And on the day of the Mainichi Hai—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, so that's Oguri Cap. Rumor has it 
she's got what it takes to win graded 
races!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii!! We came all the way from 
Kasamatsu to cheer for you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks for cheering me on. It's 
very reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Oguri seems just as usual. I don't feel 
any particularly sharp pressure from 
her...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Her reputation doesn't seem to match her 
imposing presence... Regardless, I have no 
intention of letting my guard down.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—In any case, I have only to master ‘The 
Union of Fire and Water.’”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will win this race and put my name on 
the map for the Satsuki Sho!!
